items.title: Late heroics lead the way as Blue Raiders down WKU on Homecoming
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn.- With 31 seconds left in the fourth quarter in a 42-42 game, Middle Tennessee (5-4, 3-2 CUSA) was scratching and clawing for its first win over rival Western Kentucky (3-6, 2-3 CUSA) in seven years. 31 seconds later, Middle Tennessee claimed a 51-42 win over that team in red, in possibly the most chaotic sequence of the college football season.

items.title: Blue Raiders drop weeknight finale to Kennesaw
items.summary: MURFREESBORO, Tenn.- On its final weeknight game of the season Middle Tennessee (4-4, 2-2 CUSA) lost momentum in the second half, falling to Kennesaw State (2-6, 1-3 CUSA) 44-28.

Bourgeois named a Lou Groza "Star of the Week"
items.summary: Senior place-kicker Dominic Bourgeois was selected as a Lou Groza Award "Star of the Week" for his performance in the win over FIU last week. Bourgeois was also tabbed earlier this week as the CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week.

items.title: Bourgeois earns second CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week honor
items.summary: MURFREESBORO – Senior place-kicker Dominic Bourgeois was voted the CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week as announced by the league office on Monday. This marks the second honor for Bourgeois this season.
